observation.command:
grep -qE '(^|\s)dex(\s|$)' /etc/hosts || echo "127.0.0.1 dex" >> /etc/hosts; grep dex /etc/hosts
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
# Re-extract the auth URL (state/nonce are tied to the admin session cookie we already have)
AUTH_URL=$(grep -i '^location:' start_headers.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
echo "$AUTH_URL" > dex_auth_url.txt
curl -s -c dex_cookies.txt --max-time 10 "$AUTH_URL" -o dex_auth.html -w "dex auth page: [%{http_code}]\n"
grep -o 'name="_csrf" value="[^"]*"' dex_auth.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//' > dex_csrf.txt
grep -o '<form[^>]*action="[^"]*"' dex_auth.html | head -2
